mentions.name: Vantabill
mentions.description: A free, fully offline invoicing app that installs as a single binary on Linux, Windows, and macOS, letting users go from quote to receipt with simple clicks. Data lives outside the app via an abstracted data layer to avoid lock-in and avoid hosting on someone else's server.
mentions.problem: The author needed to make invoices for occasional work but lacked budget for SaaS invoicing tools, didn't want data stored on someone else's server, and disliked that other open-source options required installing LAMP/LEMP or Node.js stacks.
mentions.source_excerpt: Vantabill (https://www.codenius.com/products/vantabill/) - I needed to make invoices for the occasional work I completed, but didn't have the budget to pay for a SaaS nor did I want my data to be online on someones server/database.
mentions.author: codenius
